content:
name: e02-m3-m20-conformance
on:
  push:
    branches: [ci/e02-m3-m20]
    paths: [environments/e02-audit/**, .github/workflows/e02-m3-m20.yml]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  e02:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: environments/e02-audit
    env:
      ARKHE_BROWSER_NODE_MODULES: ${{ github.workspace }}/environments/e02-audit/tooling/browser/node_modules
      ARKHE_E02_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/environments/e02-audit/docs/evidence/ci-e02
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.96.0
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install locked test tools and application dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix tooling/browser
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix apps/arkhe-intra
          tooling/browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install --with-deps chromium
          cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.14.0 --locked
      - name: Compile actual Rust WASM for Node and web
        run: python scripts/build_verifier.py
      - name: Native vs WASM, size checks, TypeScript, production build, keyboard and axe
        run: python scripts/verify_e02_delivery.py
      - name: Upload logs, verdicts, screenshots and source manifest
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e02-m3-m20-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            environments/e02-audit/docs/evidence/ci-e02/
            environments/e02-audit/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
          if-no-files-found: error
